dfx.example.goal: Texas family offices that invest directly in industrial businesses

description: Family offices as compact cards: class (single, multi, embedded...) with confidence, whether they invest directly, sectors and asset classes on record, check size where stated, direct investment count, latest deployment, and counts of people, sponsor and real estate relationships. A list filter sorted by one column: for a ranked answer to a buyer's criteria use rank_family_offices. Filter by states or region, canonical industries, direct investing, manager allocation, recent activity, AUM, an event type since a date, or a named co-investor. Returns dfx:fo: ids.

allocates_to_managers.description: Offices with a manager or fund commitment on record, or a stated allocation.

class.description: The classifier's verdict. A CANDIDATE is a name, never a class. NOT_FAMILY_OFFICE rows are excluded unless asked for.

co_invested_with.description: Firm names the office has co-invested with.

event_since.description: ISO date for has_event_type; default two years back.

has_event_type.description: Offices with one of these events since event_since.

has_real_estate.description: Offices with a real estate relationship on the rollup. Answers NOT_COVERED while none carries one; asset_class='real_estate' reads the stated asset classes instead.

has_sponsor_relationships.description: Offices with a CO_INVESTED_WITH or capital-provider edge to the sponsor graph. Answers NOT_COVERED with the count while no office carries one.

sector.description: A sector word or canonical code (industrial, fintech, healthcare, real estate); matched on the canonical industries array.

name: search_family_offices
title: Search US family offices
